title: Abductees tell Alberino of a forced hybrid breeding program

tellings.quote: being abducted and they're being integrated into this breeding program forcibly.

plain: People who say they were abducted describe being forced into a breeding programme meant to make human and non-human hybrids, according to a guest named Tim Alberino, who repeats what abductees have told him. If true, it would mean someone or something is using people against their will to make a new kind of being.
